content: I have dropped my fear of the dark, for the dark is where the Beloved paints the stars.
author: Hafez
explanation: Hafez reclaims the dark night of the soul not as an adversary, but as the velvet canvas across which spiritual illumination and deep faith become visible.
practicalInsight: When facing uncertainty or sadness today, trust that this quiet shadow is the necessary background for your wisdom to shine.
reflectionPrompt: How has a past period of darkness revealed radiant inner strengths you never knew you possessed?
